responsibility: Implements GCC’s current tree-level Value Range Propagation passes on SSA GIMPLE using the ranger infrastructure. It drives early and late VRP folding over CFGs, queries and updates path-sensitive/global ranges, simplifies statements and conditions from inferred ranges, removes certain __builtin_unreachable-controlled branches while reflecting the resulting exported ranges back into globals, optionally runs array-bounds diagnostics using ranger’s executable-edge knowledge, and defines the evrp, vrp, and assumptions passes that seed argument ranges from assume functions and request the necessary CFG/SSA cleanup.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for tree-level VRP: it defines the EVRP/VRP/assumptions passes and the ranger-driven folding, unreachable-edge cleanup, and diagnostics logic. By contrast, tree-vrp.h is a utility header that only declares reusable VRP/range helper functions.
